summary: Verified customer payment receipt feature independently: 9 unit tests + 4 new live-API tests + 33 regression tests (capture/void, financial integrity, reports/alert history) all pass — 68/68 total. Live flows confirmed: direct-success with customer_email sets metadata.receipt_sent_at + receipt_status='sent'; success without customer_email leaves markers absent; manual capture (metadata.capture_mode='manual' -> POST /api/payments/{id}/capture) marks receipt on capture; repeated capture with same idempotency_key returns 200 with unchanged receipt_sent_at (no duplicate send). Payment responses do not leak api keys/secrets. Feature is additive, idempotent, and non-blocking as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: payment_receipt_service.send_payment_receipt correctly guards on FINAL_SUCCESS_STATES, requires customer_email, and short-circuits on existing receipt_sent_at — idempotency is metadata-driven and survives webhook replay + capture idempotency key reuse.
Broad try/except in send_payment_receipt is intentional (never abort payment). Good — logs error, returns None.
Transient send_failed does NOT set receipt_sent_at, so a subsequent successful trigger can retry. Verified by unit test test_transient_send_failed_status_allows_retry.
HTML/text templates contain no secret-like tokens (verified against api_key/secret/password/bearer/sk_test/credential/resend).
seed_data_creation: Test payments created against tenant slug 'acme' via mock provider; RCPT-* references.
